protocol.hypothesis: Typed exchanges prevent the gate-arity, pairing and basis-cardinality errors seen in v1.
protocol.baseline_contract: Identical typed domain, fixed preparation angle, one layer, one architecture per method; same optimizer calls and seeds.
protocol.stop_rule: One batch per model; no automatic paid retries or new credit assumption.

rationale.decision: Explicit non-LLM path baseline in the identical typed grammar.

verification.business_check: All measured assets are decoded and checked against the original mandate; XY alone certifies only cardinality.
